# SOPClassification {#sec-doc}


::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}


```julia
SOPClassification
```
Abstract supertype for the classification schemes of spatial ordinal patterns (SOPs) and the type of every `refinement` argument in the package. The concrete schemes are [`OrdinaryType`](@ref) for the classical classification and the subtypes of [`RefinedType`](@ref) for the refined ones.
 


:::
